q2_gaps: Attachment of a post-nominal locative PP on the object NP ("a wreck off the point"): the instruction set gives no rule choosing between an event Location and a locative attached to the object entity, and supplies no entity-attached head for a non-containment preposition like "off" (only From is exemplified).
notes: find_out is kept as one surface symbol with no genus and no single-word synonym, as the phrasal-verb rule requires, and the eventive Agent/Theme assignment matches the progressive test ("is finding out" is fine). "Find out" with a bare NP object is marginal English, but the phrasal-verb rule attaches an object by its ordinary role, so the parse is licensed as written.
